question: In a certain code language, 'DEN' is written as 'GHQ' and 'MEN' is written as 'PHQ'. How will 'BOX' be written as in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b45f452be17f5b54f8c46069c39e0f6c931d4ce8190ab0d96cc01665e3726746.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• 'DEN' is written as 'GHQ' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eb83a60d81398b3d141bc1a03c74d3d56d072c5ef58e94eb3fa96ad013c9795.png] 

and

 
• 'MEN' is written as 'PHQ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae4d473b44228c1c87e2d2ae3d2350df78fd3dbfac67a25756d08cc3223e9232.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'BOX' : ? [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d62292ca82739c3bd8ba462049a77852b870a385a1a8ebe9dc21a2dab61f633e.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ERA**".
